Engine changes made for web display: mesh simplified to 300,000 triangles, converted to GLB, smooth normals calculated, neutral metal material applied. Gearbox and turbine changes: geometry simplified, converted to GLB and compressed with Meshopt. Gearbox texture resized and converted to WebP. Materials, lighting and camera motion adapted for all three components.
